title: AI用电要涨10倍：印度50吉瓦太阳能，为何闲置未调度？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What if I told you that every few years, India's power demand grows by the equivalent of an entire European country?
segments.zh: 如果我告诉你，每隔几年，印度的电力需求增长就相当于整个欧洲一个国家的用电量？

segments.en: And that's only the beginning. Over the next five years, India is expected to add as much electricity demand as Germany consumes in an entire year.
segments.zh: 而这只是开始。未来五年，印度预计新增的电力需求将相当于德国一整年的用电量。

segments.en: And then comes the next big customer artificial intelligence.
segments.zh: 接下来是下一个大客户：人工智能。

segments.en: Electricity demand from data centers is expected to increase at least 10 fold by 2030.
segments.zh: 到2030年，数据中心的电力需求预计至少增长10倍。

segments.en: My guests today are Praveer Sinha, the CEO and managing director of Tata Power, India's largest private sector in electricity company.
segments.zh: 今天的嘉宾是Praveer Sinha，印度最大私营电力公司塔塔电力的首席执行官兼董事总经理。

segments.en: Already nearly 40 gigawatt to 50 gigawatt of solar power is not being scheduled.
segments.zh: 目前已有近40到50吉瓦的太阳能发电未被调度。

segments.en: We need to come out of that curtailment, mind-frame and have 100% because after all you are generating power, it's pure money which is being wasted, pure energy which is being wasted.
segments.zh: 我们需要摆脱这种限电思维，实现100%利用，毕竟你在发电，浪费的是纯纯的资金和能源。

segments.en: And Mohit Pargav, country director at the India Energy and Climate Centre at the Goldman School of Public Policy at UC Berkeley,
segments.zh: 还有Mohit Bhargava，加州大学伯克利分校高盛公共政策学院印度能源与气候中心的国家主任。

segments.en: Mohit has previously led the green energy arm of NTPC which is India's largest state-owned power company.
segments.zh: Mohit曾领导印度最大的国有电力公司NTPC的绿色能源部门。

segments.en: We need to look at or focus on technologies or sources which are inherently art within our control.
segments.zh: 我们需要关注或聚焦于那些本质上在我们控制范围内的技术或资源。

segments.en: So lot of it will happen when we start decarbonizing the industry.
segments.zh: 所以很多变化会发生在行业开始脱碳的时候。

segments.en: Okay? Big chunk will happen with the AI.
segments.zh: 好吗？很大一部分会随着AI发生。
